title: pvAnnotateGlobalData
body:
## pvAnnotateGlobalData

Turns one value of a field-data (global) array into a text table: Prefix, the value formatted with Format, then Suffix, e.g. "Value is: 1.234e+05". If the array has one entry per time step it is indexed by the current time step, so the text follows the animation. The output is a one-row text table for display as an annotation, not a dataset to process further.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only field (global) arrays qualify; point and cell arrays are not listed.
- Format is a C printf pattern and must match the array type: %g/%f/%e for floating point, %d for integers; a mismatch makes ParaView warn and drop the value.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AnnotateGlobalData`. Identity: `filters/AnnotateGlobalData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: Set the input of the filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). The input needs at least one field-data array with 1 component. | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Format` | Text that is used as the C format string used by the snprintf string formatter used to convert a global data value to a string. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Prefix` | Text that is used as a prefix to the field value. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `SelectArrays` | Choose array that is going to be displayed. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Suffix` | Text that is used as a suffix to the field value. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAnnotateGlobalData",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
